server.name: remix-of-remix-of-remix-of-allma-safety-ai
server.title: Remix of Remix of Remix of Allma Safety AI

tools.name: list_my_reports
tools.title: List my safety reports
tools.description: List the signed-in citizen's own safety reports (crime, missing person, lost & found, etc.) with status and reference number.

status.description: Optional status filter, e.g. submitted, under_review, resolved.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, default 20, capped at 50.

tools.name: get_report
tools.title: Get a safety report
tools.description: Fetch one of the signed-in citizen's safety reports in full, by report id or reference number, including status history.

tools.name: create_report
tools.title: File a safety report
tools.description: File a new non-emergency safety report for the signed-in citizen. For a life-threatening emergency, tell the user to call 999 / use in-app SOS instead.

report_type.description: Type of report, e.g. crime, missing_person, lost_found, suspicious_activity, other.

narrative.description: What happened, in the reporter's own words.

location_text.description: Where it happened, in plain words.

occurred_at.description: ISO timestamp of when it happened.

is_anonymous.description: Hide the reporter's identity from public views.

tools.name: list_community_alerts
tools.title: List community safety alerts
tools.description: List currently published community safety alerts and advisories, newest first.

area.description: Optional area or district filter, matched loosely.

tools.name: find_facilities
tools.title: Find help facilities
tools.description: Find nearby help facilities such as police stations, hospitals and clinics, filtered by type, district or 24/7 availability.

facility_type.description: Facility type, e.g. police, hospital, clinic, fire.

open_24_7.description: Only return facilities open around the clock.

tools.name: manage_emergency_contacts
tools.title: Emergency contacts
tools.description: List the signed-in citizen's emergency contacts, or add a new one that will be notified when they raise an SOS.

phone.description: Contact phone number, required when adding.

relationship.description: How this person relates to the user, e.g. sister.
